name: DomainOS SR10.4

version_reference.title: Domain_OS SR10.4 - 01 VUE desktop
version_reference.role: Exact SR10.4 reference for the measured VUE controls and palette; confirmed against the running SR10.4 guest.

scope: New KDE palette only; no license of the HP reference or software is asserted.
source: Domain_OS SR10.4 - 01 VUE desktop.png plus read-only resources from the running Domain/OS SR10.4 HP VUE 2.01 guest. Original repository adaptation of measured colors; no HP file is distributed.
filename_compatibility: Plasma 6.3 uses QFileInfo.baseName() for the installed scheme ID; no internal dot. Visible name and SR10.4 colors are unchanged.
guest_version_evidence: uname: DomainOS node_123 10.4 sys5.3 DN3500; installed HP VUE 2.01 manuals; xrdb primary #7848a075d500; CoralReef palette.vue; native XQueryColors confirms primary/top/bottom/select/foreground roles

mapping.Header/Selection: VUE set 5 used by Vuefile menus and upper front panel
mapping.FrontPanel/top: VUE set 5 top shadow #a3d0e6 and bottom shadow #194b63; alternating integer pixels
mapping.FrontPanel/bottom: VUE set 3 top shadow #c4d5ed and bottom shadow #3e536e; four raised ribs

limits: KDE shares one palette across applications. VUE secondary sets 4/6/7/8 were assigned per application, which a global KDE scheme cannot reproduce without application-specific overrides.
Light and shadow are reconstructed relative to current KDE color roles; no static blue is applied after a scheme change.
panel_runtime_calibration: Window primary #78a0d5 is the relative HSL anchor for native runtime relief tones. The former prototype steel #7894a7 remains only a reference-mode/artwork key. All runtime surfaces still derive from current KDE roles; no scheme-name special case is used.

native_secondary_assignments.Vuefile: 5: blue menus, primary select 3 in recessed content
native_secondary_assignments.Vuestyle: 7: gray-blue menus/dialogs; selected indicators use select 7 with reversed shadows
native_secondary_assignments.XmList: Selected row in Vuestyle is reverse-video; KDE Selection retains its own shared semantic role
